mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing overcast skies and 66 degrees over Badger Prairie County Park. If you are looking at the sky tonight at 7:37 PM, you can catch a five-minute pass of the International Space Station traveling from the west northwest over Cross Plains toward the northeast near Madison, remaining low near the horizon.

In city news, the Verona Police Department is seeking experienced lateral transfer police officers to join their supportive, community-focused department. Additionally, the Plan Commission will be evaluating multiple development projects at their meeting on Monday, October 5th, including certified survey maps on South Main Street and in the Liberty Business Park.

We have several events coming up in our area. Today, you can head out for drop-in yoga at Insight Wellness or join Hop Haus Trivia in Verona. Tomorrow features live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Lou-ee, and looking ahead to September 20th, the Bike the Barns fundraiser will take place at Badger Prairie County Park.

In the police report, officers responded to an in-progress burglary on Thursday, September 10th, on Hunters Cove Way. A nineteen-year-old male was detained and a handgun was recovered after a shot was fired during the incident.

Over at Culver's, the restaurant is open until 10:00 PM today. Although their specific flavor of the day is listed as closed for remodel, you can still stop by before closing time to enjoy their standard menu.
